rows.grounds: passive verb of speaking or naming
locative indicating the realm of rarity

items.question: What reason establishes the goddess as both mind-captivating and rare on earth?
premises: The goddess is addressed directly as you.
She is called rare on earth.
items.inference: Because she captivates the mind, she is proclaimed rare on earth.
items.plain_english: Because you are mind-captivating, you are said to be rare on earth.
